notes: Burned in the October 2017 Tubbs Fire; all lodge/cabin buildings were lost. The current mayacamasranch.com is a WordPress 'bioregional hub' site whose originals are tiny (600px squares and 960x500 banners) and show only landscape (no buildings). Images 03, 05, 06 are from the current site (960x500, the largest available; 03 is a legacy pre-fire lawn shot). Images 01, 02, 04 are pre-fire photos recovered from the 2014-2018 Wayback Machine archive of the old site; full-size gallery originals (gal_fac_N.jpg) were never archived, only the 700x600 thumbnails, so 02 is exactly at the 700px floor. Wikimedia Commons has nothing for this venue. Not bookable.
